summary: Adds three methods to CoAP: FETCH, PATCH and iPATCH. The original CoAP methods only work on a whole resource, which is wasteful for large or complex data. These new ones let a client read or update just part of a resource.

eli5.summary: Instead of copying a whole book to change one word, you just say which word to change. These new commands let tiny devices do that.

questions: how to update part of a coap resource
